description: This PHP source file implements an API for managing WiFi EasyConnect tokens, including token generation, validation, and request handling with security features.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a cryptographic key used for token encryption.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Creates a secure token with an expiration timestamp, encrypted with AES-128-CBC.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates an encrypted token by decrypting and checking its expiration time.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests to set WiFi DPP bootstrap information.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Authenticates API callers via token or passphrase, generating tokens as needed.
